modifications: Convert FreeSurfer binary geometry and annotations to flat-array JSON
Round geometry to 0.001 mm and curvature to 0.0001
Replace unknown and corpuscallosum assignment with neutral ID 0
Add human-readable labels and source metadata
coordinate_note: Original FreeSurfer surface RAS millimeter coordinates are retained. No MNI registration or patient alignment is claimed. The supplied surface header marks volumetric geometry metadata invalid, so do not infer an MRI volume affine from it.

references.title: An automated labeling system for subdividing the human cerebral cortex on MRI scans into gyral based regions
Cortical surface-based analysis I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction
High-resolution intersubject averaging and a coordinate system for the cortical surface
